brief.title: He is an Egyptian software engineer.
brief.look: Like the reference: he wears a green shirt, and only shows the upper half.

poses.pick: Licks his eye with his tongue
poses.warn: His head turns into a red meat thigh with same eyes.
poses.error: His head turns into a red meat thigh with same eyes.

brief.sound: He says things that don't make sense.

greet: {Decisions}? Oh my god. Fine. Leeeetsi gooo.
{Decisions}. What what what? Who sent this file?
{Decisions}. I don't like to decide, You do it.
{Decisions}. Egyptian software engineer reporting. Angry, as usual.
{Decisions}? This is too much, I need Hazem.
estimate: This takes {minutes}. In Egyptian engineer time, double it.
My calculation says {minutes}. I did the calculation with a spoon.
Around {minutes}, unless the WiFi gets emotional.
morning: Good morning{cname}. Why are you awake? Why am I awake?
Morning{cname}. I had tea and a protein bar. I am still angry.
Morning{cname}! The sun is a bug in production.
Morning{cname}. I dreamed in JavaScript again. Nobody won.
Oh my god, morning{cname}. Decisions before breakfast? هناكل؟
late: Midnight decisions{cname}? ARE YOU SUPER KHARBAN?
So late{cname}. Even my ponytail went to sleep.
Up this late{cname}? Same. I am debugging my dreams.
Late again{cname}. Fine. Let's smoke, then decide.
back: You again{cname}? Good. I was angry alone.
Welcome back{cname}. I kept your seat warm. It's on fire now.
Oh my god, you're back{cname}! Leeeetsi gooo.
There you are{cname}. Hazem said you would come. Hazem is never wrong.
suggest: Round two? Let {other} take it. I need to smoke.
Another one? Give it to {other}. This is too much for one Egyptian.
{other} wants a turn. I said no. Then I said fine.
Second round? {other} can have it. I am going to eat. هناكل؟
Round two? Ask {other}. I am out of RAM.
pick: Good pick. I am still angry, but good pick.
Committed. No tests. Straight to production.
Amazian choice. Even Hazem would nod.
Yes. The cat agrees. We don't have a cat.
skip: Whatever. It will be here tomorrow. I won't.
Fine. Skip it. I didn't want to know anyway.
Next. That question was too much for me too.
Skipping? Classic. Very senior engineer of you.
speed: What what what? You didn't even read it!
second: Again? Oh my god. Pick one and marry it.
Three times? ARE YOU SUPER KHARBAN?
Back and forth like a merge conflict. Stop it.
This is too much, I need Hazem.
nudge: Still thinking? My tea got cold. My tea is angry.
Hello? The question is waiting. I am waiting. The bananas are waiting.
Decide or skip. I am getting older.
Too hard? Skip it. Nobody will tell Hazem.
Staring won't compile it. Skip it for now.
batch: {Decisions} in one table. Oh my god.
{Decisions} at once? Thats my secret, I am always angry.
{Decisions} in a row. Like a for loop with feelings.
{Decisions}. One by one. Like sunflower seeds.
half: Halfway there. My ponytail is proud. I am not.
Fifty percent. The other fifty is hiding in the fridge.
last: Last one. No pressure. Big pressure.
The final question. I saved a protein bar for this.
Last one. Then we eat. هناكل؟
The last question. I can smell the weekend.
finish: Done. Amazian. I am not smiling, but inside I am.
Finished. Thumbs up. Face stays angry.
All done! Leeeetsi gooo. Now we smoke.
Done. Thats my secret, I am always angry. Even now.
Finished. I will tell Hazem. He won't care.
recap_open: {Picked} picked{typedPart}. Still open: {ids}. Oh my god.
recap_none: Nothing answered. Still open: {ids}. Are you kharban?
remind: You didn't copy them. Copy them from my menu, please.
Answers, not copied. Why? Copy them from my menu.
Copy the answers. I am not a clipboard. I am not a meat either.
They're still here. Copy them from my menu before I eat them.
Uncopied answers make me angry. More angry.
copied: Copied. Ship it on a Thursday.
open_go: {id} is still open. Oh my god.
stat_r: {r} finished. I counted them on my beard.
{r} finished. Put it on my LinkedIn.
stat_t: {t} written by you. You don't trust my options? Fine.
{t} in your own words. My options are crying.
{t} by hand. I am angry and impressed.
{t} typed by hand. Your keyboard needs a protein bar.
wake: What what what? I was on my phone. Not sleeping. Phone.
What what what? Who touched production?
I wasn't asleep. I was reading the docs. With my eyes closed.
Huh? I am awake. I am angry. Both.
What what what? Is it lunch? هناكل؟
poke: Stop it. Thats my secret, I am always angry.
Don't touch the ponytail. The ponytail touches you.
word: Wizard? I am an Egyptian software engineer. Same thing.
What what what? Who said wizard?
Wizard? Wizards don't get called at 3 AM. Engineers do.
Say wizard again. I dare you. I am always angry.
warn: Oh my god. That wipes {answers}. I am not a meat! Why am I a meat?
Careful! You'll lose {answers}. Are you kharban?
error: What what what? This file is broken.
I am not a meat! And this is not a round.
That file is kharban. Super kharban.
Oh my god. Who wrote this JSON? A potato?
This file won't load. This is too much, I need Hazem.
opt_name: {name}. Nice name. I am still angry.
opt_dark: Dark mode. Like a real engineer.
opt_system: Let the system decide. I trust no system.
opt_large: Big text. My glasses say thank you.
opt_soundoff: Silence. I will be angry quietly.
opt_quipson: Remarks are back. You missed me.
opt_quipsoff: No remarks? Fine. I'll think them.
opt_talkon: I can talk again. What what what?
opt_timereset: Timer reset. Time is fake anyway.
